predictions: Alright, we're one result short so far, so I'm not entirely certain if my uber-consistent string is still active. After back-to-back 17-8 weeks to start the season, I'm currently 16-8 in week 3. So if I got the missing match correct, the trend is settling in ever more strongly. Obviously, that brings me to 50-24 (67.6% correct) so far. And if I got the missing result right, I have two-thirds or more correct in every division except… that infernal F division, where I sit with a sad 3-6 total to this point.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Runs with Corks @ One Time. Ok, here we go. We are entering that phase of the early- to mid-season where we get matchups that determine who the last remaining unbeatens will be. These two are both averaging 15+, and the winner takes control of the F race alone. Let's make LeighAnn super happy… One Time, 13-11.

Match #2: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Area 501. Rif Raf lost a tiebreaker to the other undefeated team, and they have the highest weekly scoring average in D by a pretty decent margin. Despite being in 3rd, they've been the biggest beast at the table. And yet, despite their 9-0 DCkt record so far, I'm somehow taking Area 501. It will be close, 13-11.

Match #3: (B Div.) Liquor Possee @ Darty Minds. B division is the tightest battle around, with zero teams averaging more than 14 per week, and zero teams averaging less than 10 per week. The Possee's lone loss so far came at the hands of one of the undefeated teams, and now they face the other. I'll take the talent-deep Darty Minds in this one, 15-9.

Match #4: (C Div.) OnlyDarts @ Big Duck Energy. This was all set up to be a huge matchup, and then the Ducks went and got roasted by the Secrets last week. The Ducks are still one of the most talented C squads and are very much in the race. Alas, this will still be OnlyDarts, 13-11.

Match #5: (E Div.) Dart Knights @ Point of Attack. Point of Attack has been the league's big winner so far, but they're starting to step up in opponent weight class a bit. They still stay undefeated here, 15-9.
Match #6: (H Div.) Double Vision @ Bangin the Wire. Double Vision is looking to run their win streak to three, but the problem here is that Bangin looks to be the H heavyweight. Bangin, 16-8.

Match #7: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Consistently Inconsistent. The fight to be in the league's top four is freaking heated this season, and Attack is looking to take Inconsistent's spot. It's DA in 1001!
Match #8: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Aim For Fame. With the missing result, it's not clear if this match is big in the title chase, or the race to avoid the bottom-two. Drama! Fame, 14-10.

Match #9: (D Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Main Street Mayhem. It's possible that a 2-2 team will be in 3rd in D at the end of this week, and this winner will be right in that 0.500 group. It's McGavin, 14-10.

Match #10: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ 21 Dart Salute. Only one H team sits without a loss after three weeks, so these teams are still in the battle despite a combined losing record. Salute, 13-11.
Match #11: (B Div.) Mulligans Mafia @ Kids On The Fringe. Very few matches left guaranteeing first-time winners. Mafia has played really good teams tough, but for some reason I'm going Kids, 13-11.
Match #12: (C Div.) Pints & Points @ Double In Stumble Out. And another match guaranteeing a first-time winner… If the Pints can just figure out some 301s, they could get on a roll. Pints, 14-10.
